newsitem.title: INDIA: Societe Generale cuts India prime rate.
newsitem.headline: Societe Generale cuts India prime rate.

text.p: Societe Generale said Tuesday it has decided to reduce its Indian prime lending rate to 17.25 percent per annum from 18.75 percent effective November 1.
Societe Generale's maximum spread above the prime lending rate would be 3.0 percentage points, its treasurer U.S. Jena told Reuters.
The spread is among the lowest announced by banks in a series of cuts in lending rates following Reserve Bank of India's monetary policy statement on October 19.
